name: closerouter

scripts.build:app: xcodebuild -project app/CloseRouter.xcodeproj -scheme CloseRouter -configuration Release -derivedDataPath dist/xcodebuild build && rm -rf dist/CloseRouter.app && ditto dist/xcodebuild/Build/Products/Release/CloseRouter.app dist/CloseRouter.app
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:app
